checks.limit: The fixed Patch model has positive dependencies and compatibility but no conflict or exclusion contract.
Selections are independent per Bundle and package; no cross-Bundle Patch constraint is evaluated.
The final sink boundary is proven to retain and emit arbitrary messages and throwable text without redaction; a typed pre-sink adapter is mandatory.
The exact-hook probe was not run because the earlier mandatory mutual-exclusion gate failed.

failedExperiments.result: Three HTTPS pushes and three parallel HTTPS clones failed through connection reset or connection timeout; SSH push and clone paths later succeeded.
failedExperiments.limit: Transport failures do not imply an upstream source or repository failure.
